description: Ontology representing the import levy regulation for cereals and rice products.

classes.name: ImportLevyRegulation
classes.description: A regulation that sets import levies on products processed from cereals and rice.

classes.name: CerealsRiceProducts
classes.description: Products processed from cereals and rice subject to import levies.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A currency used in the context of import levies and exchange rates.

classes.name: ExchangeRate
classes.description: The rate at which one currency is exchanged for another.

relationships.description: The regulation applies to the specified products.
The regulation utilizes a currency for levy calculations.
The regulation utilizes an exchange rate for levy calculations.

duties.description: Regulations impose duties related to the alteration of import levies.

legal_patterns.description: The process of altering import levies based on the average levy and current market rates.

example_instances.example_value: Commission Regulation (EEC) No 653/81 of 12 March 1981 altering the import levies on products processed from cereals and rice
based on their effective parity, arithmetic mean of spot market rates

description: Legal framework for import levies on cereals and rice as per Regulation (EEC) No 492/81.

classes.name: ImportLevy
classes.description: A levy imposed on imported cereals and rice, as defined in Regulation (EEC) No 492/81.

classes.name: Regulation
classes.description: A legal instrument, such as Regulation (EEC) No 492/81, establishing import levies.

classes.name: CCT
classes.description: Common Customs Tariff, used for classifying goods and determining levy rates.

classes.name: ECU
classes.description: European Currency Unit, the currency used for calculating import levies.

classes.name: MemberState
classes.description: One of the European Union Member States involved in the implementation and enforcement of the regulations.

legal_patterns.description: The process of calculating import levies on cereals and rice.
Applying levies to specific products based on CCT heading No.

example_instances.example_value: Monetary Committee, Whereas the import levies on products processed from cereals and rice were fixed by Regulation (EEC) No 492/81 (6), as last amended by Regulation (EEC) No 636/81 0
example_instances.source_context: Article 1: The import levies to be charged on products processed from cereals and rice covered by Regulation (EEC) No 2744/75 (9), as last amended by Regulation (EEC) No 2245/78 ( l0), as fixed in the Annex to amended Regulation (EEC) No 492/81 are hereby altered to the amounts set out in the Annex hereto.

example_instances.example_value: The import levy for products falling within heading Nos 11.01 and 11.02 is calculated based on CCT heading No as per Regulation (EEC) No 492/81.
example_instances.source_context: Article 1: The import levies to be charged on products processed from cereals and rice covered by Regulation (EEC) No 2744/75, as last amended by Regulation (EEC) No 2245/78, as fixed in the Annex to amended Regulation (EEC) No 492/81 are hereby altered to the amounts set out in the Annex hereto.

example_instances.example_value: The producer of cereal and rice products must pay the import levy as per Regulation (EEC) No 492/81.
